items.title: Using IoT Sensors for Soil Monitoring

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Using IoT Sensors for Soil Monitoring under 8.3 as printed (PDF 117, printed 113).

blocks.text: IoT sensors can collect data about soil moisture, temperature, and nutrients in real time. This information helps farmers make data-driven decisions, such as when and how much to water their crops, improving efficiency and conserving resources.
